content: Pauro mukigiinga kya Merita
Hano twaarwiiri munyaanza muyo kisi, niho twaamenyiri kubha, tuhikiri mukigiinga kya Merita.
Abhiikari bha hayo, bhakatuginihya kisi bhukongʼu. Bhakatuhuutira omuriro, kwo okubha ryaari ibhaga rye embeho, ne embura yaari eratweeka. Bhakatuginihya twoosi twoote omuriro guyo.
Pauro akateenya omurigo musuuhu gwe eziikwe. Hano yaari kutuura eziikwe ziyo mumuriro, enzoka yo obhusuungu ekiigwa eryooya ekahurukamu, ekiinaazirira kukubhoko kwaaye.

Abhiikari bha mukigiinga kiyo, hano bhaaruuzi enzoka yiyo esuruungaaziri kukubhoko kwa Pauro, bhakiimoonyererya, “Omuutu wuno yaari mwiiti. Yiingabha ahoniri okutubhira munyaanza, omusaambwa gweetu gwe ekikari guno gukubhirikirwa Eheene,
gutakumutiga ageenderere kubha muhoru.”
Nawe Pauro akakungʼuutira enzoka yiyo mumuriro, na ataanyahaarikiri naabhe hasuuhu.

Abhaatu bhayo, bhakabha bharaganya kurora kyeego Pauro araabhiimbe kasi okugwa haasi, akwe. Nawe hano bhaaganyiri kwiibhaga itaambi no okurora kubha kitariho kino kikumubhona, bhakakyoora obhugaambi bhwaabhu no okubhuga, ewe ni wumwe we emisaambwa gyaabhu.
Pauro aramuhorya wiise waabhu Puburio
Ahagiro hano twiitaambukiiri haari haguhi ne emiguundu gyo omukuru we ekigiinga kiyo, wuno yaari kubhirikirwa Puburio. Puburio wuyo, akatuginihya kisi owaaye, tukamara siku isatu.

Kwiibhaga riyo wiise waabhu Puburio yaari ahiindiiri kubhuriri, arwaariri ehooma na yaari arasaaha amanyiinga. Pauro akasikira munyuumba akamusabhira ku Taatabhugya, akamutuurira amabhoko iguru waaye, akamuhorya.
Hano gayo gaatuukiri, gakagirya abharweeri abhaandi bhoosi mukigiinga kiyo, bhakabha bharaaza ku Pauro, neewe akabhahorya.
Abhaatu bha hayo bhakabha bharatusuuka bhukongʼu. Na hano tukeenda kubhuuka, bhakatutiirirya mumeeri ebhigiro bhyeetu bhyoosi bhino twaari no obhweendi nabhyo.
Pauro arahika Rooma

Hano twaamariri emyeeri etatu mukigiinga muyo, tukataanga orugeendo kwe emeeri yimwe yino yaari etuuriri enaanga, eraganya eriibhaga rye embeho riyo rihwe. Emeeri yiyo, yaari ya mumugye gwa Arekizandiria, na yaari engʼoorirwe emisaambwa gyo okubhaazwa gya mbasa.
Tukagya tukahika mumugye gwa Sirakusi, tukiikara hayo kwa siku isatu.

Hano twaarwiiri hayo, tukiinogoora embarika we enyaanza, tukahika mumugye gwa Regio. Etabhoori yaho, omukama gukahuuta kurweera orubhaara rwa maamu, gukagirya tuhike orusiku rwa kabhiri mumugye gwa Puteori.
Hano twaahikiri eyo, tukasikana na abhiikirirya abharikyeetu, bhakatwiisasaama kubha twiikare nabho kwa siku muhuungati. Kyaamwe, tukagwaata enzira yo okugya mumugye gwa Rooma.

Abhiikirirya abharikyeetu bha Rooma, hano bhakiigwa kubha turi munzira turagya owaabhu, bhakaaza kutusuungʼaana kumuteera gwa Apio, na ahagiro hano haari kubhirikirwa Eziinyuumba Isatu zya Abhagini. Hano Pauro yabharuuzi akasaambaaruka bhukongʼu, akabhuga, “Ozomirye, Taatabhugya.”
Pauro arabhazweenia abhaatu bha Rooma iguru wa Yeesu
Hano twaahikiri mumugye gwa Rooma, Pauro akahaabhwa orugusa kubha asaage munyuumba yaaye omweene, ariikara na abhasirikare bho okumuriibha.

Eziisiku isatu zyaahitiri, akabhabhirikira abhakuru bha Abhayahudi bhasikane. Hano bhiikumeenie, akabhabhuurira, “Abhahiiri bhaane, atariho omuutu we ekigaambo kyeetu wuno nikamusariirya. Naabhe eziinyaangi zino twatigiirwe na bhazaazi bheetu, etariho yino niasarirye, nawe nikagwaatwa Yerusaremu, nikatuurwa mumabhoko ga Abharooma.
Hano Abharooma bhayo bhaamariri kunibhuurya, bhakeenda kunihaatira, kwo okubha bhataaruuzi kiyo kyoosi ekibhi kino nikakora no okugirya niitwe.
Nawe Abhayahudi bhakaanga kubha nitatazurwa. Kweego, nikasabha ekiina kyaane kitinirwe ku Kaisari. Etari kubha ndeenda kubhazoongera abhaatu bhe ekyaaro kyaane.
Gayo nigo gagirirye nibhabhirikiiri, okubha nibharore tugaambane hamwe. Enye nibhohirwe hano kwo okubha nimwiikiriirye Yeesu Krisito, ewe niwe obhwiisige bhwa Abhiiziraeri bhoosi.”

Hayo, abhakuru bha Abhayahudi bhakamukyoora Pauro bhakabhuga, “Etwe, tukyaari kubhona enyaarubha yiyo yoosi kurwa mukyaaro kya Yudea, yino ekukeerenerya iguru waazo. Na muutu wowoosi ateenda yiiza hano kugaamba ngʼana mbiihu iguru waazo.
Nawe etwe tureenda kwiigwa kyeego awe okwiiseega, kwo okubha tumenyiri enyaangi yino ogwaatiri, eragaambwa kibhi mbaara zyoosi.”

Kweego bhakiikirirania na Pauro orusiku runo bhariikumanie. Hano orusiku ruyo rwaahikiri, bhakaaza abhaatu bhaaru munyuumba yino yaari akwiikara. Pauro akabhakeerenerya iguru wo obhutemi bhwa Taatabhugya, kweema etabhoori tee engoroobha. Akasakya kubhatoongera bhoosi bhamwiikirirye Yeesu, kwo okubheegya okurwa mumigiro gya Musa na mubhitabhu bhya abharooti.
Abhaandi bhakiikirirya amangʼana gano Pauro yagaambiri na abhaandi bhataagiikiriirye.
Kweego abheene kwa abheene bhatiigwaaniri. Ambe, hano bhaagiiri, Pauro akabhabhuurira engʼana yimwe, “Ekoro Muhoreeru akagaamba amangʼana ge eheene na bhazaazi bheetu kuhitira kumurooti Isaya,

content.text: Erabha ego, kwo okubha eziikoro zya abhaatu bhanoni kongʼu,

content: Pauro akabha arageenderera kubhuga, “Ambe, bhoono emenyekane kubha obhutuurya bhuno, bhurwiiri ku Taatabhugya, na bhuhirirwe kubhaatu bhano bhatari Abhayahudi. Ebho bharabhugwaata!” [
Hano Pauro yamariri kugaamba amangʼana gayo, Abhayahudi bhakagya eno bharahakana bhukongʼu abheene kwa abheene.]
Pauro akiikara munyuumba yiyo emyaaka ebhiri migima, ewe yaari ayirihiiri akiikaramu omweene ego. Akabha arabhaginihya abhaatu bhoosi bhano bhaari kumugyaku.
Akarwaazira abhaatu kwo obhukaari iguru yo obhutemi bhwa Taatabhugya na iguru wo Omukuru Yeesu Krisito, na ataarekiibhwe.

footnotes.text: Eheene gwaari omusaambwa gwe ekikari gwe Ekirooma gwaari guriimeererera eheene, wuno agirirye obhubhi aratinirwa ekiina.
Emisaambwa gyo okubhaazwa gya mbasa gyaari girabhirikirwa Kasita na Porukusi. Emisaambwa gino gihaaseengerwa na abhahokya bha mumeeri.
